one_line: Governments tighten AI oversight, OpenAI resumes training, DeepMind resigns, and AI firms raise funding.

themes.title: Governments tighten AI oversight
themes.text: The UK will spend £100 million to create a national AI Biosecurity Lab with support from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind. The U.S. Treasury proposed expanding outbound investment restrictions on Chinese AI and biotech firms and extending the program to several other countries, while India’s SEBI announced plans for a graded broker compliance framework, an AI sandbox, and tokenised corporate bond reforms.

stories.headline: UK to invest £100 million in AI Biosecurity Lab
US Treasury proposes expanding investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms
SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: Researchers quit over Pentagon AI contract
themes.text: Two Google DeepMind researchers, Sofia Liguori and Andreas Kirsch, resigned in October, citing insufficient governance and oversight of the company’s Pentagon AI contract.

stories.headline: Two Google DeepMind researchers resign over Pentagon AI contract, oversight concerns

themes.title: OpenAI resumes training after security upgrades
themes.text: OpenAI resumed training its most capable models on October 1 after adding offline environments, high‑compute red‑team testing and fixing a Brotli compression flaw. Through its Project Daybreak programme, OpenAI’s GPT‑5.6 Sol model helped a security firm discover two critical PHP remote‑code‑execution vulnerabilities that were later patched.

stories.headline: OpenAI resumes training of frontier AI models after security overhaul
OpenAI’s Project Daybreak helps uncover critical PHP RCE bugs

themes.title: AI firms raise funding, report growth
themes.text: Pathos AI announced a $237 million Series E round at a $3 billion valuation, led by Bristol Myers Squibb and joined by AstraZeneca, NEA and General Atlantic. Infosys reported a 29 percent quarter‑on‑quarter increase in AI revenue, representing 10.5 percent of total revenue, while lowering its FY27 growth outlook to 1‑2 percent.

stories.headline: Pathos AI raises $237 million Series E led by Bristol Myers Squibb
Infosys AI revenue rises 29% QoQ as FY27 growth guidance cut to 1-2%
